title: Phase II study of trastuzumab-pkrb plus gedatolisib in patients with HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer who progressed after two or more HER2-directed therapies.

Efficacy analysis Among the 44 patients in the intention-to-treat population, two achieved CR and 17 achieved PR, resulting in an ORR of 43.2% [95% confidence interval (CI) 28.3%-59.0%; Figure 2 A]; in the evaluable population, the ORR was 44.2% (95% CI 29.1%-60.1%). According to RECIST v1.1, five patients were classified as having progressive disease (PD) due to the appearance of new lesions (three in the liver and two in the brain) despite shrinkage of target lesions, and four patients were classified as having PD due to unequivocal progression of nontarget lesions, consistent with RECIST v1.1 criteria ( Figure 2 B). The median duration of response was 4.7 months (95% CI 3.98-7.42), as illustrated in the swimmer plot ( Figure 2 C).
